_meta.description: High-level Loam roadmap. Phase-level metrics are pulled live from the DB via pipeline/analyze/loam_roadmap.py's METRIC_DISPATCH table. Set `metrics_query` on a phase to wire it to a live query; key_metrics is only a legacy fallback for phases we haven't built a query for yet.
_meta.sprint_mapping: Phases 3-6 correspond to Sprints 2-5. Phase 2 = Sprint 1 (30K Plan, done). Sprints 2 (Audit), 3 (Execute), 4 (Reference Design), 5 (Reference Enrichment) precede the old Phase 3 enrichment work, which now lives inside Sprint 5.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.notes: All reference tables seeded. Schema hardened across 3 rounds. 94 canonical tables. 17 source categories researched (docs/SOURCES.md).

phases.name: Sprint 1 — Data Population (30K Plan)
phases.summary: Quality-over-coverage catalog rebuild. 155K active wines. Closed 2026-04-11.
phases.notes: Sessions 1-14 of the 30K Plan. LWIN backbone promotion, TTB depth linking, batch imports, dedup merges, LWIN long-tail sweep. Final Josh Test 84% (222/265). Archived at data/sprints/_archive/30k/.

phases.name: Sprint 2 — Audit
phases.summary: Multi-expert read-only audit (DB, wine, code, voice, UX, meta, business) producing a prioritized Sprint 3 fix backlog

sub_tasks.name: S2.1 DB canonical + reference structural audit
S2.2 DB staging audit (32 source_* tables)
S2.3 Wine expert — canonical sample (100 wines + 50 producers)
S2.4 Wine expert — reference content (appellation_rules / grapes / soils)
S2.5 Code expert audit (pipeline/ + edge fn + scheduled tasks)

phases.notes: Complete. 9 expert sessions, 275 findings (P0-P3), $0 spent / $25 ceiling. Deliverable: data/sprints/audit/findings/synthesis.md.

phases.name: Sprint 3 — Fix
phases.summary: Execute prioritized fixes from Sprint 2's 275 findings. 6 tracks, $0 budget.

sub_tasks.name: Track 1: Clean house — drop cruft, deduplicate docs
Track 2: Staging repair + relink — 40K prices, 30K scores
Track 3: Grape + data repair — Chard/PB -90%, display_name 100%
Track 4: UI hygiene — 22 fixes across 15 files
Track 5: Edge function + code cleanup — models.py centralized
Track 6: Doc hygiene — docs updated to post-fix state

phases.notes: Complete. $0 spent. ~179 findings addressed, ~96 deferred to Sprint 4+. Plan: data/sprints/fix/plan.md.

phases.name: Sprint 4 — Reference Design
phases.summary: Redesign the reference layer (grapes / regions / appellations / producers / vineyards) and the enrichment architecture that sits on top of it

sub_tasks.name: Vertical slice selection (Sonoma Coast / California / Burgundy)

phases.notes: Design work, not build. Output is a locked plan for Sprint 5. Uses reference-layer findings from Sprints 2/3 as primary input.

phases.name: Sprint 5 — Reference Enrichment
phases.summary: Enrich the shared reference layer once; wine pages become thin synthesis over that context

sub_tasks.name: Vertical slice PoC across every layer (grape → region → appellation → vineyards → producers → wines)
Co-design frontend + enrichment with the slice

phases.notes: Scope deferred — revisit after Sprint 4 design. The old wine-level Grade B/C batch is retired; Grade B on-demand stays behind ENRICHMENT_ENABLED flag until the vertical slice ships.

phases.name: Frontend Resume

sub_tasks.name: Verify API views against current tables
Wire up Edge Function for on-demand enrichment
Loading states for Grade F/D wines
Test wine pages with real enrichment data

phases.notes: Pages already built (Wine/Producer/Appellation/Region/Grape/Country/Vineyard). Paused since 2026-04-01. Resumes with Sprint 5 vertical slice.

phases.name: Input Methods

sub_tasks.name: Label photo -> Claude Vision -> fuzzy match

phases.notes: Data layer already supports this. Needs frontend + Vision API integration.

phases.name: Data Expansion
phases.summary: Fill coverage gaps, add richer sources

sub_tasks.name: TTB COLA Phase 3 AI parse (1.35M non-001)

phases.notes: Not blocking frontend launch. Ongoing background work.

phases.name: Quality & Maintenance
phases.notes: Set up after Sprint 5 completes. Runs unattended.

phases.name: Product Layer
phases.notes: Loam can stay anonymous-first at launch. Add accounts when users ask.

phases.name: Launch
phases.notes: Target after frontend resumes with enough enrichment coverage.
